code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, severe metabolic acidosis (pH 6.9), mild anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with marked lymphopenia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, and INR, suggesting systemic inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Liver enzymes are low, possibly due to hepatic dysfunction or sample issues. There is also mild hypoglycemia and hyperchloremia. Findings are concerning for severe systemic illness (e.g., sepsis, severe COVID-19, or multi-organ failure); urgent clinical correlation and intervention are recommended.
